title: Follow-Up Reminder Priority Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=followup:reminder priority_score=*
| stats sum(priority_score) as total_value, avg(priority_score) as avg_value by contact_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks contact values by total and average priority score across follow-up reminder events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `priority_score` values for each follow-up reminder event and review total and average priority score by contact.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total priority score.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which contact shows the biggest priority score numbers in your follow-up reminder data.
